basis: Parent-facing display wording (owner refinement R-004). CDC uses “he” and “she” in alternating milestones; the app shows gender-neutral wording instead. The CDC catalog (milestones.cdc-2022.json) is unchanged and remains the source of truth. Each adaptation records the exact CDC source text and the ordered whole-word replacements; build-time validation proves that applying exactly these replacements to the source gives the display text, and that only pronouns, articles and the matching verb agreement change.
